title: Perusopetuksen järjestäminen maaseutumaisissa kunnissa The Provision of Basic Education in Rural Municipalities
text_snippet: Perusopetuksen järjestäminen maaseutumaisissa kunnissa The Provision of Basic Education in Rural Municipalities This article examines, within a spatial justice framework, the specific issues related to the provision of basic education that are constructed in the speech of municipal education experts and the local meanings these acquire in rural municipalities. The research data consist of interviews with education experts (N = 12) from three case municipalities. The data were analysed using discourse analysis. Four discourses were constructed from the data: the discourse of local scope for action, the discourse of efficiency, the discourse of social justice, and the discourse of local culture. All four discourses appeared across the case municipalities, but their interrelations took locally specific forms. Examining the relations made visible the spatial differentiation of rural municipalities and highlighted the plurality of justice-related questions in the provision of basic education. The findings raise the question of how local particularities may also contribute to inequality-producing differentiation. Understanding local perceptions is essential when pursuing socially sustainable education policy amid demographic change.

title: ”Jos jään nykyiseen lukioon, en pääse ulos kuorestani” “From rural hinterlands to the city center”
text_snippet: ”Jos jään nykyiseen lukioon, en pääse ulos kuorestani” “From rural hinterlands to the city center” In learning societies, transitions between educational degrees are a critical juncture in the life course of young individuals, particularly in rural regions where educational trajectories often require geographic mobility away from the home community. Despite the growing body of research on rural educational transitions, the perspectives of LGBTQ+ youth remain largely underexplored. Drawing on David Farrugia’s concept of the three-dimensional mobility imperative, this study investigates how LGBTIQ+ youth discursively construct their educational transitions in rural settings. The data comprises the survey (n=89) where participants describe their relationship with their childhood home and reasons for leaving. The analysis combines corpus assisted and critical discourse analysis. The results illustrate that moving for education is an unquestionable structural imperative, but also a discursively constructed possibility to move from heteronormative and socially restrictive rural to urban environments imagined as liberal. title: Lukiokoulutuksen läpäisy ja keskeyttäminen Passing and dropping out of general upper secondary education
text_snippet: Lukiokoulutuksen läpäisy ja keskeyttäminen Passing and dropping out of general upper secondary education This article examines regional differences in general upper secondary school completion within the target time (three years), dropout rates, and what changes occurred in the above-mentioned areas between those who started general upper secondary school between 2019 and 2021. The analysis is based on register data from the Finnish National Agency of Education (KOSKI database), which contains information on completion and dropout rates. Regional variation in completion and dropout rates was visualized using the Kriging method. The result showed clear regional disparities in both on-time graduation and dropout rates. Students attending rural general upper secondary schools were more likely to graduate within the target time than their peers in urban schools. Between 2019 and 2021, the share of students graduating on time decreased slightly, while the proportion of dropouts increased modestly. The article concludes with a discussion of the results in relation to the broader goal of promoting educational equality.

title: Koulunkäynnin tilat maaseutukoulujen etäopetuksessa Spaces of schooling in rural schools’ remote teaching
text_snippet: Koulunkäynnin tilat maaseutukoulujen etäopetuksessa Spaces of schooling in rural schools’ remote teaching The decline in the number of children, challenges in the availability of qualified teachers, and increasing distances require many municipalities to consider new ways of organizing their statutory basic education services. Remote teaching has often been proposed as a potential means to ensure the provision of basic education throughout Finland in the future. However, its position in the education governance system is not yet established. This article examines the views of municipal basic education actors on how different practices of remote teaching are transforming the pupils’ spaces of schooling in rural schools. These spaces are examined from a sociomaterial perspective. The research data consisted of interviews with heads of local education department, comprehensive school principals, teachers, and municipal decision-makers (N=22) from five different municipalities. The data was analyzed using the principles of data-driven content analysis. title: Kouluterveydenhuolto ja koulukeittolat Suomen maalaiskansakouluissa 1920- ja 1930-luvuilla School Healthcare and School Kitchens in Rural Primary Schools in Finland in the 1920s and 1930s
text_snippet: Kouluterveydenhuolto ja koulukeittolat Suomen maalaiskansakouluissa 1920- ja 1930-luvuilla School Healthcare and School Kitchens in Rural Primary Schools in Finland in the 1920s and 1930s This article analyses the development of school health services and school kitchens in Finnish rural primary schools in the 1920s and 1930s. The main source material consists of primary school inspectors’ reports from the years 1925/26–1938/39, which provide a quantitative overview of the development of these services. The importance of school health services and school kitchens was emphasized in Finland following the 1921 Compulsory Education Act, but the lack of state-level coordination and decentralized decision-making led to regional variation in service provision. In the late 1930s, over a quarter of municipalities lacked school health services, and school kitchens were operating in less than half of all rural primary schools. Like the expansion of the rural school network, the development of its student welfare services before World War II was slow and unequal.School kitchens and school health services were more common in wealthier municipalities. School health services were also provided more frequently in municipalities that had a municipal doctor or a local association of the Mannerheim League for Child Welfare or Samfundet Folkhälsan i svenska Finland. title: Erilaisuuden kokemukset maaseudun koulumuistoissa 1980- ja 1990-luvuilla Experiences of Difference in Memories of Rural Schooling in the 1980s and 1990s
text_snippet: Erilaisuuden kokemukset maaseudun koulumuistoissa 1980- ja 1990-luvuilla Experiences of Difference in Memories of Rural Schooling in the 1980s and 1990s In this article, we ask what was perceived as difference and how experiences of difference are remembered in rural school environments during 1980s and 1990s. The data consist of 20 oral history interviews, analysed using theory-driven content analysis. Methodologically the study draws from the history of experience and oral history research. The findings show how experiences of difference in rural school memories are shaped in relation to the small size of the school and the surrounding rural community. In a small school, experiences of difference are shaped by the small and tight school community and particular teaching arrangements. Perceptions of difference appear to be rooted in pupils' skills, behavior, and newcomer status, rather than material distinctions. In the rural community, experiences of difference are defined in relation to family livelihood, income, and social status. The findings demonstrate how communities’ social hierarchies can be reflected in children's everyday lives as intergenerational experiences of otherness. title: Näkökulmia suomalaisen varhaiskasvatuksen tutkimuksiin eri tieteenalojen e-kirjoina julkaistuissa väitöstutkimuksissa
text_snippet: Näkökulmia suomalaisen varhaiskasvatuksen tutkimuksiin eri tieteenalojen e-kirjoina julkaistuissa väitöstutkimuksissa This article examines Finnish early childhood education research through a systematic literature review of doctoral dissertations. The aim of the study was to analyze the research methods, subjects, and themes of dissertations (N=80) related to early childhood education, published as e-books between 1975 and 2022 at Finnish universities across various academic disciplines. The results indicate a clear predominance of qualitative research methods over quantitative and mixed-method approaches. Furthermore, the child's perspective is more prominently represented than that of the service provider. The most common research themes focus on early childhood pedagogy. The analysis of pedagogy reveals a need for further research into how pedagogy is defined and understood in early childhood education, as well as whether the treatment of pedagogy in academic texts is overly narrow. title: Koettu itsesensuuripaine ja polarisoivista aiheista keskustelemisen seuraukset yliopisto-opiskelijoilla Perceived Self-Censorship Pressure and the Consequences of Discussing Polarizing Topics Among University Students
text_snippet: Koettu itsesensuuripaine ja polarisoivista aiheista keskustelemisen seuraukset yliopisto-opiskelijoilla Perceived Self-Censorship Pressure and the Consequences of Discussing Polarizing Topics Among University Students Societal polarization affects university teaching by making topics that divide the nation difficult to discuss, even in the realm of science. This study examines how university students perceive their opportunities to discuss socially polarizing topics in the classroom, as well as their experiences, fears, and intentions related to such discussions. Respondents to our survey (N=210) expressed a desire for open dialogue, but about half reported being cautious about expressing views or questions that could be interpreted as offensive or cause them to be labeled. While concern over the consequences of disagreement was evident, the perceived risk of facing public criticism appeared relatively low. The article discusses how university teaching could simultaneously create space for diverse perspectives and foster critical scientific thinking.

title: Ilmapiiri, muistot ja lapsuuden poliittiset maailmat Atmosphere, memories and the political worlds of childhood
text_snippet: Ilmapiiri, muistot ja lapsuuden poliittiset maailmat Atmosphere, memories and the political worlds of childhood Our article examines what kind of political worlds children live in. The starting point for this study was a workshop organised in summer 2022 under the heading Finlandized childhood? The workshop arose from frustration with one-sided stories about post-war Finland. Based on it we, researchers who grew up in four decades, began to investigate the matter. With the help of memory-work, we strive to reach out to the political experiences of childhood, where politics was not only institutional activity, but also formed into everyday, affective and material dimensions. Employing the concept of atmosphere, we analysed how YYA Finland’s childhoods were built with layers and multiple voices. In the article, we look back on the traces of war, the opening of the political world, the politics of the school and the era of Soviet friendship. Our analysis highlights how memory-work and the concept of atmosphere open up the affective aspects of politics and help us understand the construction of divisions and the building of meanings in the past and present. title: Kestävän kehityksen varhaiskasvatuksen malli A Model for Sustainable Early Childhood Education and Care
text_snippet: Kestävän kehityksen varhaiskasvatuksen malli A Model for Sustainable Early Childhood Education and Care In recent years, the framework and goals of sustainable development have been more prominent in Finnish and international policies and curriculum texts at different levels of education and training. This also applies to early childhood education and care. However, studies - and general messages from the field - in Finland and elsewhere show that there is still much to be desired in terms of putting the framework into practice. In this article, we therefore present 1) the UN Framework for Sustainable Development and 2) related national and international policies on education and training, 3) ecosocial and planetary theories of civilisation, 4) general pedagogical principles and starting points for early childhood education and care, and 5) a model for sustainable development in early childhood education and care, based on the research literature in the field, as a basic framework for curricula and practice in the field. We believe that the "wicked problems" of our time require that a model along these lines be set as the primary basic framework for all early childhood education and care activities. title: Itseohjautuvuuteen kasvattaminen suomalaisen kasvatusfilosofian ja sivistysajattelun valossa
text_snippet: Itseohjautuvuuteen kasvattaminen suomalaisen kasvatusfilosofian ja sivistysajattelun valossa Kirjoituksessani tarkastelen itseohjautuvuuteen kasvattamista suomalaisen kasvatusfilosofian ja sivistysajattelun näkökulmasta. Lähtökohtana on ajatus, että itseohjautuvuus on olennainen, mutta ei itsestään syntyvä taito, joka edellyttää pedagogisesti perusteltua ja suunnitelmallista kasvatusta. Itseohjautuvuuden juuret kytkeytyvät suomalaisen kasvatus- ja sivistysajattelun perinteeseen, jossa korostetaan yksilön vapautta, kriittistä omaa toimintaa tiedostavaa ajattelua ja vastuullisuutta yhteisön jäsenenä. Eettisesti vastuullinen ja yhteisöllisyyttä arvostava kasvatus jatkaa suomalaista kasvatusfilosofista perinnettä, jossa kasvatuksen tavoitteena on tukea oppilaan itsenäistä ajattelua ja minäpystyvyyttä.Opetuksen ja kasvatuksen päämääränä on antaa oppilaalle valmiudet ohjata omaa toimintaansa ja kasvaa vastuulliseksi yhteiskunnan jäseneksi.

title: Menneisyyden ihmisen ymmärtäminen ja historian oppimateriaalien eläytymiseen ohjaavat draamatehtävät Understanding Persons from the Past through Empathic Engagement Drama tasks in History Study Material
text_snippet: Menneisyyden ihmisen ymmärtäminen ja historian oppimateriaalien eläytymiseen ohjaavat draamatehtävät Understanding Persons from the Past through Empathic Engagement Drama tasks in History Study Material The teaching of history strengthens the student’s capacity to empathize with individuals from the past. Empathy building drama exercises are one way to improve one’s historical empathy. In our article, we will look at the empathy building tasks of digital books and teachers’ digital materials in the 7th and 8th grade in basic education, aimed at strengthening historical empathy and understanding the people from the past. Our analysis combines data and theory-based content analysis. This study examines the nature of historical empathy as manifested in educational tasks, focusing on three dimensions: (1) the forms of empathic engagement are present, (2) the working methods, activities, outputs, and learning materials used, and (3) the presence of historical empathy dimensions – contextualization, perspective-taking, and affective connection – in task instructions. Our findings indicate that the tasks analyzed foster diverse forms of empathy engagement, such as adopting the role of a fictional historical character and seeking to understand their actions and choices. title: - Bhutan – transformatiivisen kasvatuksen edelläkävijämaasta mallia suomalaiselle peruskoululle?
text_snippet: - Bhutan – transformatiivisen kasvatuksen edelläkävijämaasta mallia suomalaiselle peruskoululle? Bhutan on kehittyviin valtioihin kuuluva, noin 800 000 asukkaan pieni kuningaskunta Himalajalla, Intian ja Kiinan välissä. Kasvatustieteen maisteri, Oulun yliopiston väitöskirjatutkijana toiminut Päivi Ahonen on tehnyt uraauurtavaa työtä tutkimusmatkoillaan Bhutaniin ja sen naapurivaltioihin. Matkoillaan hän ihastui erityisesti bhutanilaisten lasten transformatiiviseen, oppilaan ajattelutapoja ja arvoja muuttavaan, kouluopetukseen, jossa korostetaan ennen kaikkea kestävää kehitystä ja siihen tiiviisti liittyvää onnellisuutta talouskasvun sijaan. Hän tutki, miten Bhutanissa toteutetaan näitä periaatteita maan peruskoulujärjestelmässä. Ahosen tutkimus sisältää neljä julkaistua tiedeartikkelia, joissa tarkastellaan teemaa eri näkökulmista. Tehtävänä oli selvittää, miten kestävän kehityksen periaatteet näyttäytyvät osana Bhutanin koulujen opetusta. Tavoitteena oli selvittää, miten Bhutanin Gross National Happiness (GNH) eli bruttokansanonnellisuuden kehitysperiaate näkyy koulujen opetuksessa koululaisten ja opettajien näkökulmista. title: Yksityisen varhaiskasvatuksen palvelusetelin sääntökirjat The Rulebooks of Private Early Childhood Education Vouchers
text_snippet: Yksityisen varhaiskasvatuksen palvelusetelin sääntökirjat The Rulebooks of Private Early Childhood Education Vouchers The present study is concerned with an investigation into the management of inclusive early childhood education (ECE) within the framework of public management values. The primary focus of this research is the rulebooks of private early childhood education vouchers (N=32) that have been established by municipalities, with a particular emphasis on the terms they contain for facilitating inclusion. The objective of our review is to elucidate how these terms influence the promotion or restriction of inclusive ECE. In addition, we examine the implications of the interpretative nature of the regulations and public management values for the leading inclusive ECE in the municipal context. Theory driven content analysis was used to identify the terms promoting the inclusive rights of the child and equal treatment of the families (n = 113): increasing the value of the service voucher, being heard, non-discrimination and permanence. The limiting terms (n = 56) were: limiting families’ possibilities for choice and denying special support. title: ”Jos pää kestää, niin pärjäät lukiossa” "If you can handle it mentally, you'll succeed in high school"
text_snippet: ”Jos pää kestää, niin pärjäät lukiossa” "If you can handle it mentally, you'll succeed in high school" In this article, we investigate the strategies employed by girls in Finnish general upper secondary schools (GUS) to construct their relationship with the student ideal present in the school context. Our research brings the voices of these girls into an era emphasising individualism, self-direction, freedom of choice, and self-responsibility. In their everyday school life, girls navigate both the pressures of GUS studies and the demands of conforming to a narrow normative femininity. Our interest in this topic stems from previous research highlighting the inequitable and gendered practices of schooling as well as challenges related to girls’ well-being. The data consist of 11 in-depth interviews, analysed through dialogical thematisation by categorising strategies that illustrate how girls negotiate their relationship with the student ideal. From the interviews, we identified four strategies: managing alone, striving for excellence, criticising imposed responsibility, and distancing from normative femininity. title: Vanhempien jännitteiset kasvatuskumppanuuden ideaalit kodin ja koulun yhteistyössä Tensions in Parents’ Ideals of Home–School Partnership
text_snippet: Vanhempien jännitteiset kasvatuskumppanuuden ideaalit kodin ja koulun yhteistyössä Tensions in Parents’ Ideals of Home–School Partnership Since the 1990s, educational policies have emphasized the importance of parental involvement in their offspring’s schooling. Home-school collaboration is positively associated with students' academic achievement, well-being and school satisfaction. The ideal home-school partnership is based on shared expertise, mutual respect, trust and dialogicity. However, not all parents have equal opportunities to participate in home-school collaboration. Practices often overlook family diversity and power dynamics, marginalizing parents' voices. This study explores parents' perspectives on home-school partnership ideals and related power dynamics, using responses from 921 parents as part of the larger survey. Our approach emphasizes the discursive nature of home-school partnership and highlights how dominant discourses shape social realities and practices in both home and school contexts. The results reveal diverse and often tense views among parents. Despite the discourse of partnership, parental involvement is often limited to teacher-parent discussions, event organization, and receiving information. title: Pohdinta sanattomasta yhteydestä varhaiskasvatuksen näkökulmasta Reflections on wordless connection from the perspective of early childhood education
text_snippet: Pohdinta sanattomasta yhteydestä varhaiskasvatuksen näkökulmasta Reflections on wordless connection from the perspective of early childhood education In this article, we examine wordless connection, particularly from the perspective of early childhood education. We reflect on wordless connection in relation to Martin Buber’s ideas about the world relation in which encounter, connection, and dialogue are realized, and we ask what kinds of meanings wordless connection can have in early childhood education. The inquiry has been carried out in a dialogical process, and the main working method has been thinking with theory. During the research process, we have tried to move away from human-centered thinking, allowing time and space for moments of wordless connection to occur also in relation to more-than-human world. Wordless connection often exists in activities that are carried out purely for the sake of doing them and do not require the qualities or skills typical for adults. Openness, unhurried wondering and sensing the world without the need to have control are at the heart of wordless connection. Wordless connection seems to become possible in moments where one approaches another without expectations or goals: the aim is not, for example, learning, development, or becoming a better person, but rather what there is in the moment

title: Opettajaopiskelijoiden näkemyksiä monilukutaidosta ja sen pedagogiikasta Student Teachers' Perspectives on Multiliteracy and Its Pedagogy
text_snippet: Opettajaopiskelijoiden näkemyksiä monilukutaidosta ja sen pedagogiikasta Student Teachers' Perspectives on Multiliteracy and Its Pedagogy In this article, we examine how Finnish language teacher students conceptualise multiliteracy and implement it in their subject-specific studies. The research data consists of visions related to multiliteracy produced by students (n = 19), concerning of the lesson plans, and a supplementary questionnaire. The data were analysed using data-driven content analysis. The results show that the students conceptualise multiliteracy as a broad, multidimensional skill. Their understanding of texts is characterised by multimodality, and they emphasise the importance of fostering pupils’ agency, critical thinking and interaction skills. However, the text selections in the lesson plan compilations were mainly based on textbook materials, and the production tasks were predominantly traditional written texts. Based on these findings, we consider how teacher education succeeds in modelling multiliteracy pedagogy. It appears that teacher students have internalised the ideals of multiliteracies pedagogy, but these ideals are not yet strongly realised in their lesson plan compilations.

title: Taimet tarhassa? Seedlings in a garden?
text_snippet: Taimet tarhassa? Seedlings in a garden? The seedling is linked to Finnish early childhood education and its historical background in several ways. On the one hand, seedling refers to a child, that is, a human seedling, who, when well cared for, grows into a full bloom. On the other hand, seedling also refers to nurseries (kindergarten) as ”childgardens”. Seedling is also related to gardens that were connected to kindergartens, where planting and caring for plants has been practiced with the children. In the same way, there have been gardens in connection with seminars training kindergarten teachers. This article reflects on the relevance of the educational discourse on the plant world in our time, when the way of being that is specific to plants has begun to be understood in a new way. We convey our thoughts through perspectives on the teaching garden: the data was collected by interviewing two gardeners who work in a garden connected to one of Finland's oldest teacher training institutions. The seedling discourse and material are examined in a posthumanist and new materialist spirit emphasizing the mutual relativity of humans and plants, and the whole article is framed by the idea of growth as co-existence.

title: Kansalaiset pienoiskoossa?
text_snippet: Kansalaiset pienoiskoossa? Lasten osallisuus näyttäytyy tutkimuksessa päämääränä, jonka toteutuminen vaatii aikuisilta laajaa tietämystä lasten oikeuksista, yhdenvertaisuudesta ja syrjimistä ehkäisevistä käytänteistä, sekä pedagogisista ratkaisuista, jotka tukevat osallisuutta. Tässä tutkimuksessa tarkastellaan opettajien puheessa tuotettuja diskursseja lasten osallisuudesta perusopetuksessa. Tutkimusaineisto koostuu kuudesta (6) luokanopettajan teemahaastattelusta. Aineistoa analysoitiin diskurssianalyysin periaattein yhdistäen kielenkäytön luonnetta laajempaan yhteiskunnalliseen kontekstiin. Opettajien puheesta konstruoitiin kolme erilaista diskurssia: sosiaalisen pääoman diskurssi, vastuudiskurssi ja valtadiskurssi. Sosiaalisen pääoman diskurssi painotti oppilaiden sosiaalisia ominaisuuksia ja verkostoja, jotka pohjautuivat sosiaalisen pääoman ideologiaan. Vastuudiskurssissa korostuivat kasvatusvastuu sekä yhteiskunnallinen kilpailukyky, jonka taustalla vaikutti uusliberalistinen koulutuspolitiikan ideologia. Valtadiskurssissa korostui puhetyyli valtapositiosta, mikrotasolla opettajien kuvauksissa oppilaista ja makrotasolla yhteiskunnan sekä koulutuspolitiikan kuvauksissa. title: Tiedekasvatus ja demokratia tutkivassa yhteisössä
text_snippet: Tiedekasvatus ja demokratia tutkivassa yhteisössä Tiedekasvatus on globaali ilmiö, joka on vakiintumassa osaksi suomalaista kasvatuskenttää. Tällä hetkellä tiedekasvatusta lähestytään monitieteisyyden ihanteesta huolimatta pääsääntöisesti luonnontieteiden kautta, ja koulutuspoliittisia tavoitteita ura- ja työmarkkinavetoisesti. Tutkimusten mukaan tiedekasvatusta leimaa lisäksi demokratiavaje. Keskustelua tarvitaan tiedekasvatuksen kasvatuksellisista periaatteista. Tässä artikkelissa tarkastelemme tiedekasvatusta demokratiakasvatuksen viitekehyksessä. Avaamme tiede- ja demokratiakasvatuksen välisiä yhteyksiä sekä kasvatussosiologista taustaa. Ehdotamme tutkivaa yhteisöä (community of inquiry) demokraattisen tiedekasvatuksen käsitteelliseksi ja pedagogiseksi perustaksi. Tutkiva yhteisö yhdistää tieteellisen ja demokraattisen elämäntavan ja toimii siten siltana tiedekasvatuksen, sen eri oppiaineiden sekä demokratiakasvatuksen välillä.

title: Kun ope ragee
text_snippet: Kun ope ragee Vaikka opettaja–oppilas-suhdetta ja siinä koettuja tunteita on viime vuosina tarkasteltu runsaasti, on vähemmälle huomiolle jätetty suhteessa ilmenevien vihan tunteiden monimerkityksellisyys. Tässä tutkimuksessa tarkasteltiin oppilaiden kokemuksia opettajan vihan tunteista pedagogisessa suhteessa. Tutkimusaineisto kerättiin sähköisellä kyselylomakkeella sekä yksilö- ja parihaastatteluin kuudesluokkalaisilta (n=97) ja analysoitiin temaattisen sisällönanalyysin sekä composite vignette -menetelmän keinoin. Tutkimus osoittaa, että oppilaiden kokemukset opettajan vihan tunteista ovat paitsi epäreiluja, satuttavia ja voivat liittyä suhteen konfliktisuuteen, mutta erityisesti tilanteita sivustaseuranneiden kokemana myös ymmärrettäviä ja tarpeellisia, joskus huvittavia tai ristiriitaisiakin. Analyysin perusteella oppilaalle opettajan vihan tunteet eivät ole yksiselitteisesti negatiivisia vaan pikemmin ambivalentteja: toisaalta tarpeellisia ja oikeutettuja, mutta potentiaalisesti vaarallisia ja satuttavia. title: Inkluusion kehitys suomalaisessa perusopetuksessa
text_snippet: Inkluusion kehitys suomalaisessa perusopetuksessa Artikkeli tarkastelee retrospektiivisenä näkymänä tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden käsitteisiin liitettyjä merkityksiä peruskoulun opetussuunnitelman perusteissa eri aikoina (1970–2014) sekä sitä, miten niiden varassa tehdyt uudistukset peilautuvat erilaisiin käsityksiin inkluusiosta. Tutkimuksen aineisto muodostui viidestä peruskoulun opetussuunnitelman perusteista vuosilta 1970, 1985, 1994, 2004 ja 2014 keskittyen opetussuunnitelmatekstin arvoihin, tavoitteisiin ja käytännön uudistuksiin. Aineisto analysoitiin käsiteanalyysin ja teorialähtöisen sisällönanalyysin yhdistelmällä. Tulosten mukaan kaikista peruskoulun opetussuunnitelmista välittyi tasa-arvon ja inklusiivisen koulutuksen henki. Tasa-arvo näkyi oppilaiden osallisuutta kuvaavina arvoina muuttuen ajan kuluessa tasa-arvon näkemisestä samanlaisuutena kohti erilaisuuden ymmärtämistä moninaisuutena. Inkluusio rakentui vaiheittain heijastaen pääosin laajaa ja tukiorientoitunutta inkluusiokäsitystä. Uudistukset painottivat kaikkien oppilaiden opettamisen (mm. tuntikehys) ja erityistukea tarvitsevien tuen (mm. osa-aikainen erityisopetus) kehittämistä. title: Miksi medialukutaidosta tulee edelleen puhua?
text_snippet: Miksi medialukutaidosta tulee edelleen puhua? Onko medialukutaidon käsitteellä enää käyttöä tekoälyn, datan ja koneoppimien ajassa? Kyllä on. Tässä puheenvuoroartikkelissa perustelen medialukutaidon käsitteen tarpeellisuutta sen proaktiivisen luonteen näkökulmasta. Artikkeli tarjoaa lyhyen katsauksen erilaisten lukutaitomääritelmien evolutiivisiin kaarin ja sijoittaa datanlukutaidon kaltaiset ”uudet lukutaidot” osaksi suurempaa kuvaa.
